description: Quantify ProteomicsDB peptide evidence for Q9H9K5 and test directly whether any public peptide ends at Q432
code:
import requests, json, os
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
seq="".join(requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q9H9K5.fasta",timeout=60).text.split("\n")[1:])
N=len(seq)
url="https://www.proteomicsdb.org/proteomicsdb/logic/api/proteinpeptideresult.xsodata/InputParams(PROTEINFILTER='Q9H9K5')/Results"
rows=requests.get(url, params={'$format':'json'}, timeout=90).json()['d']['results']
df=pd.DataFrame(rows)
df['START_POSITION']=df.START_POSITION.astype(int); df['END_POSITION']=df.END_POSITION.astype(int)
print(f"ProteomicsDB records for Q9H9K5 (ProteomicsDB protein 81327): {len(df)}")

pep=(df.groupby(['PEPTIDE_SEQUENCE','START_POSITION','END_POSITION'])
       .agg(n_psm_records=('ID','size'),
            n_projects=('PROJECT_NAME','nunique'),
            projects=('PROJECT_NAME', lambda s: "; ".join(sorted(set(s))[:3])),
            pmids=('PUBMEDID', lambda s: ",".join(sorted({str(x) for x in s})[:4])),
            best_q=('PEPTIDE_Q_VALUE', lambda s: float(np.min(pd.to_numeric(s)))))
       .reset_index().sort_values('START_POSITION'))
print(f"\nUnique peptides: {len(pep)}\n")
print(pep[['PEPTIDE_SEQUENCE','START_POSITION','END_POSITION','n_psm_records','n_projects','best_q','pmids']].to_string(index=False))

cov=np.zeros(N+1,dtype=int)
for _,r in pep.iterrows(): cov[r.START_POSITION:r.END_POSITION+1]+=1
covered=int((cov[1:]>0).sum())
print(f"\nSequence coverage: {covered}/{N} = {covered/N:.1%}")

ends=set(pep.END_POSITION); starts=set(pep.START_POSITION)
print("\n=== THE DIAGNOSTIC QUESTION ===")
print("Peptide ending exactly at Q432 (shed neo-C-terminus)?  ", "YES" if 432 in ends else "NO")
print("Peptide starting exactly at R433 (stub neo-N-terminus)?", "YES" if 433 in starts else "NO")
print("Peptide ending at R433 (fully tryptic, uninformative)? ", "YES" if 433 in ends else "NO")
print("Is residue 432 covered by ANY peptide?                 ", "YES" if cov[432]>0 else "NO")
print("Coverage depth at 420-445:", list(cov[420:446]))
print("\nPeptides overlapping 400-500:")
sub=pep[(pep.END_POSITION>=400)&(pep.START_POSITION<=500)]
print(sub[['PEPTIDE_SEQUENCE','START_POSITION','END_POSITION','n_psm_records']].to_string(index=False) if len(sub) else "  NONE")

# verify all peptide coordinates against the UniProt sequence
bad=[(r.PEPTIDE_SEQUENCE,r.START_POSITION,r.END_POSITION) for _,r in pep.iterrows()
     if seq[r.START_POSITION-1:r.END_POSITION]!=r.PEPTIDE_SEQUENCE]
print("\ncoordinate mismatches vs Q9H9K5 sequence:", bad if bad else "none (all peptides map exactly)")

# tryptic-space accounting: how much of the protein is even observable by tryptic MS?
import re
cuts=[0]+[i+1 for i,c in enumerate(seq) if c in 'KR']+[N]
tryptic=[(cuts[i]+1,cuts[i+1]) for i in range(len(cuts)-1) if cuts[i+1]>cuts[i]]
obs=[(s,e) for s,e in tryptic if 6<=(e-s+1)<=40]
obs_res=set()
for s,e in obs: obs_res.update(range(s,e+1))
print(f"\nTryptic peptides of length 6-40: {len(obs)} covering {len(obs_res)}/{N} = {len(obs_res)/N:.1%} of the protein")
print(f"Observed {covered} of those {len(obs_res)} MS-accessible residues = {covered/len(obs_res):.1%} of the observable space")
tp=[ (s,e) for s,e in tryptic if s<=432<=e ][0]
print(f"Tryptic peptide spanning 432: {tp[0]}-{tp[1]} = {seq[tp[0]-1:tp[1]]}  (length {tp[1]-tp[0]+1})")
print(f"Shed-form semi-tryptic diagnostic peptide: 423-432 = {seq[422:432]} (length 10, mass-distinguishable from the tryptic 423-433 by one Arg = 156.101 Da)")

os.makedirs(os.getcwd(), exist_ok=True)
pep.to_csv(os.path.join(os.getcwd(),"ERVMER34-1_proteomicsdb_peptides.csv"), index=False)

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(13,4.0))
ax.fill_between(np.arange(1,N+1), cov[1:], step='mid', color='#4299e1', alpha=.75, label='ProteomicsDB peptide depth')
for s,e in obs: ax.axvspan(s,e,ymin=0.0,ymax=0.045,color='#2f855a',alpha=.6)
ax.axvspan(489,509,color='#feb2b2',alpha=.5,label='TM 489-509')
ax.axvline(432.5,color='k',lw=2.2); ax.text(432.5, cov.max()*1.12,'Q432/R433',ha='center',fontsize=9)
ax.set_xlabel('Q9H9K5 residue'); ax.set_ylabel('n distinct peptides')
ax.set_ylim(0, max(2,cov.max()*1.25))
ax.set_title(f'ProteomicsDB evidence for Q9H9K5: {len(pep)} peptides, {covered/N:.0%} coverage, none reaching the Q432 shedding site\n(green bars = tryptic peptides 6-40 aa, i.e. the MS-observable space)')
ax.legend(fontsize=8, loc='upper right'); plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
